There are four problem sets. Homework 1 is due
Wednesday, August 5, and each subsequent homework is due one week later.

Each assignment is distributed and submitted through **Classroom 50**: click the
assignment invite link, which creates your personal repository
from the template. Clone it, work locally, then `git push` to submit. Run
`] activate .` then `instantiate` inside the repo once to set up the Julia
environment.

Solutions are released after each homework's due date.
